instruction: Love is not a spiritual discipline (Sadhana); Love, in itself, is the state of unitive consciousness (Samadhi). Faith (Shraddha) and Devotion (Bhakti) are preliminary stages; Love is a transcendent state accessible only to the supremely fortunate. In Love, the subject (the lover) and the object (the Beloved) merge into an indivisible unity, where neither dualism nor non-dualism pertains. The intellect is effaced, the mind-stuff (Chitta) ceases its fluctuations. This very phenomenological state is designated as 'Samadhi'.
subtitle: Ramashram Satsang (Ch. Sh.)
title: The Supreme Preceptor
